decisionsTitle: «Spune-ne ceva»: the chosen event, day and chip in the address, and separators between the backoffice card's four forms (amending §676, §680, §696)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-11:** «când selectez ceva în formularul ăsta de feedback, vreau să pun în query params ca să pot să fac share la evenimentul deja selectat»; and, of the backoffice card that switches the four forms on and off: «Și aici am nevoie de separatoare».

**Decision.**

- **The address follows the choice.** The page already preselected from `?eveniment=` and `?data=`; now the browser writes them back. Choosing an event (the filtering island's box or the native select), setting the day, or pressing a kind chip calls `history.replaceState`, which Next 16's App Router folds into the router, so there is no navigation, no re-render of the server page and no extra back-button step. The chip is `?fel=special` or `?fel=group`; «toate» is no word at all, and the page reads it to open on that chip. «Altceva / în general» and an emptied day remove their word. A refusal's words (`error`, `fields`, `since`) and the sent mark are dropped when a choice is written, so a shared link never carries an outcome. Nothing personal is ever written: a slug, a day, a chip's name. The pure rule is `addressSearchWith` in `event-picker.ts`; the browser half is `feedback-address.ts`, and `FeedbackAddressSync` (one `change` listener on the form, drawing nothing) covers the native select and the date box.
- **Separators on «Spune-ne ceva» in «Pagini» → «Contact».** A divider between each of the four forms and one before the save button, in the Administrator's form.

**What does not change.** The form's posted fields, the draft cookie, `?tip=`, the server's tolerance for a slug the club does not publish, and every word.

**Left for the owner.** Whether the chip belongs in a shared link at all; it is there because it is cheap and the owner said «ceva».
changelogLine: - **«Spune-ne ceva» keeps the chosen event in the address** — the event, the day and the kind chip are written to the link without a reload, so it can be shared with them chosen; the backoffice card of the four forms has separators between them. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Choosing an event, a day or a kind chip on «Spune-ne ceva» writes it into the address (`?eveniment=`, `?data=`, `?fel=`) without a navigation, never writes a refusal's words, and the page opens with it chosen (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
